descriptionChirho: Gera, a Benjamite proper name borne by several individuals in the Hebrew Bible (father of Ehud, son of Bela, etc.); attested across all grammatical contexts including standalone and conjunctive forms. English 'Gera', Spanish 'Guera/Guerá', Hindi गेरा, Arabic جيرا/جِيرَا, Korean 게라, Swahili 'Gera'. The conjunctive prefix waw (and-Gera) is purely grammatical and does not alter the referent.
